parameters.query: INSERT INTO agent_executions (project_id, agent_name, status) VALUES ($1::uuid, 'agent_briefing', 'running') RETURNING id

SELECT p.id, p.name as project_name, p.project_type, p.budget_target, p.budget_flexible, p.location_address, p.location_city, p.location_province, p.property_type, p.property_area_m2, p.urgency, p.current_phase, p.metadata, p.briefing_hash, c.name as client_name, c.email as client_email, pii_decrypt(c.phone_enc) as client_phone, c.preferred_contact, pii_decrypt(c.notes_enc) as client_notes , (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('type', pathology_type, 'severity', severity, 'description', description, 'affects_safety', affects_safety, 'recommended_action', recommended_action, 'cost_min', estimated_intervention_cost_min, 'cost_max', estimated_intervention_cost_max) ORDER BY CASE severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 0 WHEN 'high' THEN 1 WHEN 'medium' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END) FROM pathology_findings WHERE project_id = p.id AND status NOT IN ('repaired','dismissed')) AS pathology_findings FROM projects p JOIN clients c ON c.id = p.client_id WHERE p.id = $1::uuid

WITH briefing AS (SELECT id, version, summary, pii_decrypt(client_needs_enc)::jsonb AS client_needs, objectives, constraints, status FROM briefings WHERE project_id = $1::uuid ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT * FROM briefing UNION ALL SELECT NULL::uuid, 0::int, NULL::text, NULL::jsonb, NULL::jsonb, NULL::jsonb, 'new_project'::text WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM briefing)
SELECT content, model_recommended, temperature FROM agent_prompts WHERE agent_name = 'agent_briefing' AND prompt_type = 'system' AND is_active = true LIMIT 1

parameters.query: UPDATE briefings SET status = 'approved', approved_at = NOW(), approved_by = 'architect' WHERE id = $1::uuid
UPDATE approvals SET status = 'approved', decided_by = 'architect', decided_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1::uuid
UPDATE agent_executions SET status = 'completed', finished_at = now() WHERE id = $1::uuid; UPDATE briefings SET exec_status = 'confirmed' WHERE execution_id = $1::uuid
UPDATE briefings SET status = 'revision_requested' WHERE id = $1::uuid
UPDATE approvals SET status = 'rejected', decided_by = 'architect', decided_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1::uuid

INSERT INTO project_intelligence (project_id, agent_name, key, value) VALUES ($1::uuid, 'agent_briefing', 'briefing_intelligence', $2::jsonb) ON CONFLICT (project_id, agent_name, key) DO UPDATE SET value = EXCLUDED.value, updated_at = now()
